headline: Peltola beats Sullivan in Alaska Senate race
source: Associated Press, via Just Security and Democracy Now
pages: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has defeated Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska, according to reports on Tuesday. Democracy Now put the result at 50.1 percent to 45.8 percent and said Peltola is the first Indigenous woman from Alaska elected to the Senate. It was the last Senate race to be called, and the win brings the Democratic Senate majority to 56 seats. Drop Site News reported that the result may not be the end of the matter. It said the Justice Department has accused Peltola's campaign of helping put a spoiler candidate also named Dan Sullivan on the ballot, that the investigation has stalled in court, and that Gov.-elect Mike Dunleavy said Alaska could withhold certification.

The outcome shifts the balance in a chamber that shapes federal policy for the next two years.
Source: Associated Press, via Just Security and Democracy Now
